items.title: One action
items.description: A single, clear goal — enquire, book, download — instead of many equally-weighted options.

faq.title: What you'd want to know beforehand.

items.question: What's the difference between a landing page and a website?
items.answer: A website represents your whole business. A landing page pursues a single, concrete goal — a campaign or an offer, for example.

items.question: How fast can a landing page go live?
items.answer: Since the scope is much smaller than a full website, a landing page usually launches noticeably faster.

items.question: Do I need a separate landing page for every campaign?
items.answer: It depends on the goal. For different audiences or offers, a dedicated page per campaign usually gives more clarity than one shared page.
